exercises.instructions: Combine the following sentences using 'too … to'.

questions.question: He was very nervous. He could not perform well on the stage. Combine using 'too ... to'.
options: too nervous to perform well on the stage
too nervous performing well on the stage
too nervous for perform well on the stage
questions.answer: too nervous to perform well on the stage
questions.explanation: Use 'too + adjective + to + V1' when the subject is the same. 'Too nervous to perform well on the stage' is correct. 'Performing' uses wrong form. 'For perform' is grammatically incorrect. 'Too ... to' ကို အတူတူပဲ ခေါင်းစဉ်နှစ်ခု ပေါင်းဖို့ သုံးပါ။
